item.description: Booking -> Payment -> Notification success flow. Notification verification is hybrid: keep the SSE request open in a separate Postman tab to observe the payment event.

item.description: Support request only. This does not prove delivery by itself; it helps verify notification-service is alive while the SSE tab is open. For grading, show the open SSE request receiving a payment event after the payment step succeeds.

item.description: Run 1-3 seconds after the PAYMENT_FAILED request. Expected final status in this repo is CANCELLED via Kafka compensation.

item.name: TC27 - Poll Driver Current Ride
item.description: Run after at least one successful booking while the driver is ONLINE. When a ride offer exists, this returns type=offered and a ride object with id.

item.description: Run when the previous request returns type=offered and sets offeredRideId.
